content: Kyakin, bi kàkwe anki mukaŋ mpem, waa bàyweer naa yubwaŋ bi isàsal bi mpɛl u bul a Atɛn.
Bi kàmàlatööm un'tɔŋ abi Tumàtɛ, mbaay abi unsà isal a Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ a Klistɔ, ntɔn mukàlalɛɛl anà mukàlapà ngwal unsà làkwikilà abɛ,
ntɔn, akumwɛy uboo a bɛ ukɔɔn akwɛlà unsà mpay aŋàdiir yi. Ntɔn bɛ làkyàyöb bɛ ŋakwo naa bi bibel ntɔn mpay ayi.
Mpal kàkäl bi apà bɛ, bi kàlaweey naa bi bàkyer asimɛɛy nkwaaŋ. Abun ya sye yan'mɛnà asànaa làyöb bɛ ya ubwaŋàbwaŋ.
Asànaa mɛ kàfàkwo anki mukaŋ mpem, mɛ kàtöm Tumàtɛ ntɔn muyöb naa làkwikilà abɛ là aben. Bɔɔmà amɛ làkäl naa manà Un'lwɛb kàlalwɛb, anà isal kàkyer bi ikyà bwà.

Apà, Tumàtɛ kan'yàfurà kàfü nde akà bɛ, anà kàmipà làsaŋ aŋàbwaŋ là làkwikilà abɛ anà lukwen abɛ. Nde kan'tɛn naa bɛ làfàyɔbà bi taaŋ lanswà anà làbà anà ngyal mufiman asànaa ibà bi sye anà ngyal mukàlaman.
Apan, atɔŋ, bi kan'wal ndɛɛl amu bɛ, u mbwo a làkwikilà abɛ, uboo a ngyɛb aŋàdiir abi yanswà anà mpay abi.
Apanà, bi kan'fàyaabà, ntɔn bɛ làbà aŋàtsim unsà un'tüüb abɛ anà Mwol.
Bi Nzam abi ifun'kömà aben u ndaa abɛ, ntɔn un'sak wanswà làmipà bɛ kusà ande?
Mpib anà mwäänà, bi ifàlɔm akà nde unsà muküünà ntɔn nde kipɛ mbwo mufàlaman anà mukwɛy undiir akɔ̈ɔ̈n u làkwikilà abɛ.
Wɛy Nzam nde ŋakwo, anà Mwol Yɛsu biduub mbwo muyà akà bɛ!
Wɛy Mwol uyɛɛl anà ukwɛy ukwen làbà bɛ abà bɛ a bɛ anà akà baar banswà, asànaa ifàlakwen bi.
Wɛy nde upɛ ngwal u mpem abɛ, ntɔn wa ukäl win'kyɛɛl anà wàbalàbal kusà a Taaràbi Nzam, umpal usàyà Mwol abi Yɛsu anà aŋin'kyɛɛl ande banswà. Wöwöö.
